343367.師父エンスウは きよめの水を使って\n世界樹の頂を 清めてまわった。:
Master Ensuu used Fresh Water to purify the
Crown of Yggdrasil.

343368.そして 風通しのよい場所を 探し当てると\n幻桃の花を うやうやしく供えた……。:
Then, after finding a well-ventilated spot,
she reverently placed the Ghost Peach Blossom
there.

343370.「我は 風の神エルドナの眷属にして\n 嵐を統べる霊鳥 エンスウ。:
I am Ensou, a spirit bird who commands the
storms and serves Eldona, the God of the Wind.

343371.「今こそ 揺るぎなき決意を ここに示さん。\n 風よ……我が主の意思を いざない:
The hour has come to show my unbreakable
resolve. Wind, bear my lord's will aloft.

343372.<center>……私は 風の神エルドナ……: ...I am Eldona, the God of the Wind...

343373.<center>幻桃の花の清らかなる香り\nたしかに 我がもとへ 届きました。:
The pure fragrance of Ghostpeach Blossom has
indeed reached me.

343374.<center>ストームカイザー 嵐帝エンスウ。\nそして <pc>……。\nあ:
Storm Kaiser Kaiser Ensuu. And <pc>.
Let's hear what you have to say.

343375.「我が主 エルドナ神よ。\n かの幽谷にほどこした いにしえの封印は\n ついに:
My Lord Eldona. The ancient seal binding that
Shadowy Vale has reached its breaking point
and is starting to crack.

343376.「私は ストームカイザーの継承者\n <pc>と共に マガツタタリカゼを討伐し\:
Together with the heir to Storm Kaiser, I am
determined to defeat The Winds of Dread and
dispel the malevolent gales.

343377.<center>マガツカゼ……人の絶望 恨みや恐怖といった\n負の感情が けがれ:
The Winds of Malice...this wicked wind is born
from despair--emotions like resentment and
fear--and has wrought countless calamities.

343378.<center>それを はらい清めるでも 封じるでもなく\n完全に討滅するとなれ:
If the plan is not just to fend it off or seal
it away, but to utterly destroy it, then a
battle beyond imagination surely awaits.

343379.<center>エンスウ。あなたは 慈悲深き霊鳥。\nゆえに 弟子たちの犠牲を嫌:
Ensou... You are a merciful spirit bird. That is why you have always refused to let your disciples make sacrifices and have continued
to seal the wicked winds away at the bottom of the valley, haven't you?

343380.「しかし 結果的に 問題を先送りにして\n 弟子たちを 苦しめてしまったのも事実:
But it's also true that I kept putting the
problem off, and in the end my disciples paid
the price... Time to face it.

343381.「ここに <pc>が現れた。\n 私の翼を支えてくれる 最強の弟子が。:
<pc> appeared here--my strongest
disciple, who supports my wings.

343382.「<pc>とならば 使命を果たせます。\n ……必ずや。:
If that's the case, I'm certain I can fulfill
my mission.

343384.<center>……いいえ よいでしょう。かつて\n世界を守らんと願った 勇敢な:
...No, that's fine. O brave little bird who
once wished to protect the world, I understand
your will.

343385.<center><pc>。あなたに問います。\nエンスウと共に ストームカイザー:
<pc>, I ask you: Are you ready to
fulfill the mission of Storm Kaiser alongside
Ensou?

343386.しかし <pc>の返事は\n強い風の音に かき消されてしまった！:
However, <pc>'s reply was drowned out
by the howling wind!

343387.<center>その決意……\nしかと 聞き届けましたよ。: I've heard your resolve... loud and clear.

343388.<center>あなたがたに 風の加護を授けました。\nたとえ 深いケガレの底に:
I have bestowed upon you the protection of the wind. Even if you find yourselves at the very depths of impurity, you will be able to fully
demonstrate your true abilities.

343389.<center>悪しき風をはらい 未来へ進みなさい。\nストームカイザーたちよ…:
Cast aside the evil winds and march toward the
future, Storm Kaisers.

343390.「<pc>……。\n 私は おまえを 最後の弟子にするよ。:
I'll make you my final disciple,
<pc>.

343391.「私たちが マガツタタリカゼを消滅させれば\n 新たなストームカイザーは 必要な:
If we destroy The Winds of Dread, we won't
need another Storm Kaiser. Let's charge in
with that spirit... that's the idea.

343392.「さあ いくさの準備を ととのえたら\n 草庵の北から 封邪の幽谷へ向かおう。\:
Now that you've finished preparing for battle, head from the north of the hermitage toward Corrupted Canyon. You must destroy The Winds
of Dread.

343393.<cs_pchero>は 師父エンスウと共に\n封邪の幽谷へ 向かった。:
<pc> heads to the Corrupted Canyon
with Master Ensuu.

343395.「封印を わざわざ解くまでもない。\n ほころびは すでに大きく……\n もうす:
No need to break the seal myself. The crack's
already wide... He'll be here soon.

343397.「森羅万象を侵す ケガレの根源よ……\n 試すがいい。私たちの覚悟を。:
O root of impurity that corrupts all things in
the universe... Go ahead and test us. Test our
resolve.

343398.「退く道など 最初からない。\n 我らが歩むは 嵐のただ中。:
There was never any way to turn back. We walk
right into the eye of the storm.

343399.「剣は 我が信念。\n 風は 我が魂……:
The sword is my conviction. The wind is my
soul...

343400.「双翼の嵐 ストームカイザー。\n いざ……参る！！:
Storm of the Twin Wings, Storm Kaiser! Here I
go...!!

343401.「これで 終わらせる。\n 私に続け <cs_pchero>！:
Let's wrap this up. Follow my lead,
<cs_pchero>!

343402.「我らが 双刀……\n 悪しき風を 断たんがために！:
Our twin blades... to cut through the evil
winds!

343403.「嵐 吹き荒れ\n 滅せよ マガツタタリカゼ！！:
Let the Storm Rage and Destroy! The Winds of
Dread!!

343406.「よくやってくれた <cs_pchero>。\n おまえと私で 大いなる風となり:
Well done, <cs_pchero>. Together, you and I
became a mighty gale and at last achieved a
great triumph.

343407.「私たちは……最強の師弟だ。: We are... the mightiest master and apprentice.

343408.「もし エルドナ神の加護がなければ\n ここまで 耐えきれなかっただろうね。:
If it weren't for Eldona's protection, I
probably wouldn't have been able to hold out
this long.

343409.「一人前のストームカイザーとなった\n おまえならば 察しているだろう。:
As a full-fledged Storm Kaiser, you must have
figured it out by now.

343410.「マガツカゼは まだ 滅びていない。: ...The Winds of Malice still yet blow.

343411.「ストームカイザーとして 数千年にわたって\n ケガレをはらい清め 封じてきた私:
As a Storm Kaiser, I have spent thousands of
years purging and sealing away impurity, and I
have always been with those wicked winds.

343412.「老いた弟子たちが 蝕まれたように\n 私の風も 今の戦いをもって\n ついに:
Just as my elderly disciples were corrupted,
so too has my wind--through this battle--
finally been tainted.

343413.「剣と風を極めし 霊鳥たるこの身すら\n 歳月の刃には 抗えぬとはね。:
Even I, a spirit bird who has mastered sword
and wind, cannot withstand the blade of time.

343414.「しかし これは 予測できていたこと。\n だからこそ おまえを弟子にとり\n:
But this was to be expected. That's exactly
why I took you on as my disciple and guided
you this far.

343415.「ストームカイザー <cs_pchero>。\n 私を倒し この世に残った\n:
Storm Kaiser <cs_pchero>... Defeat me and
obliterate the last of the Winds of Malice
that still plagues this world.

343416.「酷なことを頼んでいるのは わかっている。\n ……おまえは 心根が優しいからね:
I know I'm asking you to do something cruel...
but you're such a kind-hearted person.

343417.「一度 この場を 立ち去りなさい。\n 覚悟が決まったら……ここにおいで。:
Leave this place for now. When you're ready...
return.

343419.「来たね <cs_pchero>……。\n 始める前に すべてを伝えておこう。:
Here you are, <cs_pchero>. Before we begin,
let me fill you in.

343420.「マガツタタリカゼを 討ち果たした今\n この世界に残った 最後のマガツカゼは\:
With The Winds of Dread defeated, I am the
last of the wicked winds left, still cloaked
in its impurity.

343421.「おまえは 覚えているかな。\n カミハルムイで 弟子のギンセンの\n けがれた:
Do you recall? At Kamiharmui, I severed my
disciple Ginsen's corrupted aura and sent him
on his way.

343422.「その時 ギンセンは ストームカイザーの\n チカラを喪失し ただの人に戻った…:
At that moment, Ginsen lost the power of Storm
Kaiser and returned to being just a normal
person.

343423.「しかし 私は 人ではなく\n ストームカイザーという存在そのもの。\n ゆえに:
However, I am not human--I am Storm Kaiser.
Therefore, if you sever my gale, this life
shall perish.

343424.「そんな顔をする余裕も じきになくなるぞ。:
Soon, you won't have the luxury of making that
face.

343425.「霊鳥たる このエンスウの風は\n おまえの全力をもって かからなければ\n 決:
After all, the wind of this Ensou--a sacred
bird--can never be cut through unless you
attack it with all your might.

343426.「ゆえに おまえの全力を引き出すため\n 私も 死力を尽くして 立ち向かう。\n:
That's why, to bring out your full potential,
I'll also give it my all and face you head-
on... I won't hold back.

343428.「……ケガレに蝕まれた私は やがて\n マガツタタリカゼと 成り果てる。:
...Consumed by impurity, I will eventually
become The Winds of Dread.

343429.「今は エルドナ神の加護で\n 抑え込んでいるが……\n もはや 一刻の猶予もな:
For now, Eldona's protection is keeping it at
bay... but it seems we don't have a moment to
spare.

343430.「今こそ ストームカイザーの使命を果たせ。\n 覚悟はいいね <cs_pcher:
The hour of Storm Kaiser's mission has come.
Are you ready?<yesno><close>

343431.「この使命を果たせるのは 他の誰でもない\n 私の一番弟子である おまえしかいな:
The only one who can fulfill this mission is
you--my top disciple--and no one
else.<cs_pchero>...Right?<yesno><close>

343432.「決意を秘めた よい目をしている。\n さすがは 私の最後の弟子にして 最強の弟:
He has a determined look in his eyes. As
expected of my last--and strongest--disciple.

343434.<center>ストームカイザー <cs_pchero>。\nおまえに 決闘を申:
storm kaiser <cs_pchero>. I challenge you to
a duel.

343435.<center>弟子たるもの いつかは 師を超えねばならぬ。\nならば 今日がそ:
A disciple must one day surpass the master. If
that day has come, then this is it.

343436.<center>あるいは……\n弟子が師を超えるなど 夢物語。\nそれを この一:
Or... the notion that a disciple can outshine
their master is pure fantasy. I'll prove it in
this one battle.

343437.<center>どちらが 嵐帝の名を冠するに\nふさわしいか ここで 決めよう。:
Let's settle right here which of us is worthy
to bear the name "Arashi-tei."

343438.<center>ストームカイザー 嵐帝エンスウ。\nいざ 参る！！: Storm Kaiser Kaiser Ensuu. Here I come!!

343448.<center>ストームカイザー\n嵐帝を継ぐ者よ。\nこの世界……託したぞ！:
storm kaiser, heir to the Storm Emperor. This
world... I entrust it to you!

343449.<center>……私は……\nよき師で あっただろうか？: ...Did I make the grade as a mentor?

344852.「この世界をけがす 最後のマガツカゼが\n 今ここで 完全に消滅した……。:
The last of the Winds of Malice has been
completely destroyed...

344853.「ストームカイザー <cs_pchero>。\n 大いなる使命を果たした者よ。\:
storm kaiser <cs_pchero>. O one who has
fulfilled a great mission. You, above all, are
worthy of the title "Storm Emperor."

344854.「その証として 最後に これを贈ろう。\n よくぞ……師を超えた。:
As proof of that, I'll give you this parting
gift. Well done... you've surpassed your
master.

344855.「ただ 覚えておきなさい。\n マガツカゼは 人の絶望や恐怖から 生まれる。:
Never forgetーthe Winds of Malice are born
from the fear and despair in people's hearts.

344856.「人の負の感情を なくすことはできない。\n それを否定することは この世で生き:
It's impossible to eliminate people's negative
emotions. Denying them is the same as denying
life itself.

344857.「この先 もしも マガツカゼが現れた時は\n ストームカイザーのおまえが\n ケ:
Should the winds ever threaten us again,
you--the Storm Kaiser--must purge the
corruption and protect this world.

344858.「悠久の時の中 多くの者を見送ってきたが\n 愛弟子に 最期を見送ってもらえると:
Throughout the ages, I have watched many companions take their final bow, yet to have my dear disciple see me off at the end--well,
I count myself a lucky man.

344859.「風立ちて 我は還らん 空の果て\n 君に残せし 嵐の誇り……。:
The wind rises--I shall return, leaving you
the pride of the storm at the edge of the sky.

349241.<center>ストームカイザーの使命を果たすと 誓いますか？<yesno><c:
Do you swear to fulfill the mission of Storm
Kaiser?<yesno><close>

349242.<pc>と 師父エンスウは\n世界樹の頂を あとにした。:
<pc> and Master Ensuu leave the
Crown of Yggdrasil behind.
